verdict.rationale: Ironclad exposes broad API surface (Records, Workflows, Webhooks, Templates, Data Exports, BYOSP) letting technical users read/write contract data and trigger/launch workflows programmatically, and docs explicitly note webhook creation is possible via both UI and API. However, core authoring tasks like designing workflows in Workflow Designer and building contracts in the No-Code Builder are documented as UI-only steps that must be completed before the API can launch/interact with them, showing real parity gaps rather than full UI/API equivalence. Missing for 10: API support for workflow design/authoring itself, no-code contract builder equivalence via API, and independent/hands-on confirmation of full feature parity.
